headline: Profit jumps and full-year production guidance raised
summary_short: Diamondback Energy reported Q2 FY2026 revenue of $5.56 billion, up 51.2% y/y, with GAAP diluted EPS of $6.65 (vs $2.38 a year ago) and net income of $1.88 billion.
summary_long: Revenue rose 51.2% year-over-year to $5.56 billion. GAAP net income attributable to Diamondback rose to $1.88 billion ($6.65/diluted share) from $699 million ($2.38/share) a year ago; adjusted net income (excluding derivative and debt-extinguishment items) was $1.83 billion ($6.48/diluted share). The company generated $2.33 billion of free cash flow, repurchased $141 million of stock, declared a $1.10/share base dividend, reduced total debt by ~$1.3 billion q/q to $12.8 billion, and doubled its share-repurchase authorization to $16.0 billion. Diamondback raised full-year 2026 oil production guidance to 522+ MBO/d (from 520+) and total production to 1,000+ MBOE/d (from 972+), while holding full-year capex guidance unchanged at ~$3.9 billion.
confidence_notes: The resolver's shard KPI (eps_usd: $6.48) is the company's Adjusted (non-GAAP) diluted EPS, while its prior_qq/prior_yy figures ($0.08, $2.38) are GAAP basic/diluted EPS from SEC XBRL -- a cross-basis mismatch in the wire feed. This summary reports both the GAAP diluted EPS ($6.65, matching the release's own income statement, vs $2.38 y/y GAAP) and the Adjusted EPS ($6.48) as separate rows to avoid conflating them; the 'vs guidance' label on Adjusted EPS reflects the release's own comparison framing, not a company-issued EPS guidance figure. Revenue and net income are read directly from the filed income statement (not on the shard's kpis object, which only carries EPS for this shallow-coverage ticker).

drivers.explanation: Revenue and profit growth reflect higher realized commodity prices and volumes; the company did not break out a specific price-vs-volume attribution in the release's highlights section.
